# Usage specimens

The top-level files are reconstructed specimens, not raw captures. Real,
sanitized captures are under `captured/` (see below).

- `weekly-only.jsonl`: the weekly-only prolite shape and 89% used reported in
  issue #198, wrapped in the token_count envelope already exercised by
  `tests/bats/usage.bats`. The timestamp and reset are test values.
- `two-windows.jsonl`: the 0%/5% example in
  `tests/bats/limit-codex-status.bats`, whose envelope was confirmed against a
  real rollout on 2026-09-10. It is a reconstruction of that existing fixture.
- `status.txt`: the documented vendor status example from that test file.
  It is an independent text expectation, not output generated by clikae.

Tests move event and reset times relative to the test clock, leaving percentages
and durations unchanged. Malformed and swapped variants are synthetic mutations.

## captured/ (captured 2026-11-19, sanitized)

Real `token_count` events copied from codex rollout files on one machine, one
file per plan shape. The two `plus-transient-*` files were added later the same
day with the same sanitizer. Sanitized: each line keeps only `timestamp`, `type`,
`payload.type` and these `payload.rate_limits` fields: `limit_id`, `plan_type`,
`rate_limit_reached_type`, and each window's `used_percent`, `window_minutes`
and `resets_at`. No account identifier, email, path, prompt, model output or
token count remains. Values are unmodified; tests shift every timestamp and
reset by one common offset, so durations, percentages and event-to-reset
distances are the captured ones.

- `plus-two-windows.jsonl`: a plus plan with 300- and 10080-minute windows,
  followed by the empty `premium` event codex writes right after it.
- `prolite-weekly-only.jsonl`: prolite, one 10080-minute window as `primary`.
- `team-weekly-only.jsonl`: team, one 10080-minute window as `primary`,
  followed by an empty `premium` event with a credits-depleted reason.
- `plus-zero-duration.jsonl`: a plus plan event whose only window reports
  `window_minutes: 0` (seen once in a live session), after a normal event.
- `plus-transient-weekly-only.jsonl`: a plus event with both windows, then
  one 33 seconds later whose only window is the 10080-minute one as
  `primary` (the weekly-only shape, on a plan that has both). The next event
  in the source rollout had both windows again.
- `plus-transient-window-only.jsonl`: a plus event with both windows, then
  one 6 seconds later with the 300-minute window and `secondary: null`.
  The next event in the source rollout had both windows again.

No vendor `/status` text was captured alongside these. The status-text check
still uses `status.txt` above; the captured check compares usage JSON with
clikae's own status renderer instead.
